status: isolated_source_candidate_created; CPU scheduling model checked; not CUDA-compiled, GPU-tested or reviewed
decision: Test bounded complete-K stripe rounding before a full scheduler rewrite. Do not unconditionally remove split-K.

anchor.scope: Hopper BF16 NVFP4 EP; original M128..256 gate/up and corresponding down calls; current128-thread N128/K64 config;FP32 reduction and no weighted/atomic GEMM
anchor.only_change: Conditionally round per-CTA stripe length to complete-K multiple; no MMA/scales/reduction/store modifications

source_evidence.fact: Every CTA derives valid-block count by scanning the complete expert-block list in EP specialization.
K/N tiles and per-CTA stripe length are computed from valid block count; stripe length is ceil(K_tiles*N_tiles*valid_blocks/gridDim.x).
Initial valid-block lookup scans from beginning when invalid blocks exist; subsequent lookups advance from previous block.
init_slice derives each stripe/output-tile intersection and the number/order of K-split CTAs.
FP32 global reduction reads previous partials and writes nonfinal partials, masking some padded rows.
Lock acquisition, global FP32 reduction and release only occur when slice_count>1.
Bucket=local_expert_id+1; filtered -1 routes occupy bucket0, before valid experts.

symbols.V: number of valid padded M blocks = sum_e ceil(local_route_count_e / block_M)
symbols.D: invalid prefix M blocks = ceil(nonlocal_route_count / block_M)
symbols.K: K tiles per output tile =4096/64=64 for measured configuration
symbols.N: output N tiles =8192/128=64 for gate/up;4096/128=32 for down
symbols.I: ceil(K*P/G), original maximum stripe K-tile count

exact_arithmetic_model.count_scan_work: G*B loop iterations at CTA level per GEMM. This is not an instruction count or DRAM byte count: threads share uniform accesses and caches can serve repeated reads.
exact_arithmetic_model.split_boundaries: {j*I |1<=j<G, j*I<K*P, (j*I)%K !=0}; distinct floor(boundary/K) counts split output tiles.
exact_arithmetic_model.scratch_upper_bound: 2 * number_of_boundaries * block_M *128*4 bytes (read+write FP32 partials). Padded-row masks can reduce actual traffic; hardware traffic must be measured.
exact_arithmetic_model.fullK_unconditional: I_full=ceil(I/K)*K; every stripe boundary aligns with output-tile K boundaries, so existing init_slice yields slice_count=1.
exact_arithmetic_model.tradeoff: Rounding increases maximum per-CTA K work and reduces active CTAs in the tail. Removing locks can lose more in load balance than it saves. Fraction of split output tiles is not fraction of execution time.

assumptions: N tile128,K tile64; grid396 CTAs from incumbent Nsight M8/M128; confirm runtime grid before extrapolating.
Histograms reconstruct alignment padding; invalid bucket is ordered first by the +1 bucket convention.
Source-level CTA loop and scratch upper-bound counts, not executed instructions, DRAM traffic, or measured time.
FP32 scratch upper bound ignores partial-row masks; real traffic may be smaller.

why_low_M_falls_back.M8: Median gate/up stripe inflation1.36x and down1.52x for unconditional rounding; down has only272 output tiles for396 CTAs. Eliminating split-K would reduce available parallelism.
why_low_M_falls_back.M128: Median split-output fractions20.3% up/42.8% down, but unconditional stripe inflation1.14x/1.33x. A bound excludes most harmful cases.
why_low_M_falls_back.M256: Median split-output fractions15.7% up/29.6% down; median stripe inflation1.067x/1.091x makes bounded scheduling plausible. Estimated FP32 scratch upper bound is only~6.3MB per GEMM, so the hypothesis is synchronization/load scheduling, not a huge DRAM-byte elimination.

implemented_candidate.change: Insert one compile/runtime guarded adjustment immediately before slice_row computation; all downstream existing scheduling/math/store code retained.
compile_guard: 128 threads, M blocks1, N tile128, K tile64
runtime_guard: gate/up N8192,top_k8,original M128..256 OR down N4096,top_k1,expanded M1024..2048
implemented_candidate.operation: I := I_full only when all guards hold.
implemented_candidate.historical_application_rate: On20 routing samples per shape: changes M128 gate/up40%, down0%; M256 gate/up70%, down30%. Other measured M cases untouched by shape guard. These are source-model predictions, not runtime measurements.
implemented_candidate.zero_case: V=0 ->I=0; explicitI>0 prevents rounding. Original empty-route path and masked finalizer remain intact.
implemented_candidate.overflow: New products/rounding use int64_t and cast only after explicit signed32-bit range check; full_K_tiles is compile-time64. Original preexisting stripe expression remains unchanged; declared shape/input bounds keep it within signed32-bit.
math_invariants: No change to FP4 decode, block/global scales, MMA fragments, BF16 activation boundaries or finalizer.
All K tiles assigned exactly once; output ownership differs only by removal of split boundaries.
FP32 accumulation order changes relative to distributed partial reduction; unchanged numerical oracle and full-model output-agreement gate still required.
No new atomic BF16 reduction, host synchronization, omitted expert, or altered norm.
No extra allocation, metadata kernel, global work queue or weight repack.
Dynamic decision depends only on already device-resident routing counts and uniform kernel shape values; it is graph safe in design, still requires capture/replay tests.

cpu_validation.proof_observed: For modeled P values, original and bounded partitions cover [0,K*P) without gaps/overlap; changed schedules have slice_count1 and max-stripe inflation<=10%; zero-work cases remain empty.
cpu_validation.limits: CPU arithmetic checks do not validate CUDA compilation, pointer progression, GPU races, precision, graph safety or performance.

secondary_scan_candidate_not_implemented.idea: Export invalid-prefix block count from alignment and pass it to both GEMMs; replace total valid-block scan and initial lookup with V=B-D and block_id=D+par_id.
secondary_scan_candidate_not_implemented.implementation_path: Reuse alignment cumsum metadata for generic align; tiny-align fast path must explicitly publish equivalent prefix count. Preserve default API and use opt-in metadata pointer. No new standalone count kernel unless its launch cost is included and justified.
secondary_scan_candidate_not_implemented.legality: Only valid for the verified bucket-ordered +1 offset alignment contract; arbitrary expert_ids with interior -1 blocks must retain original scan. Prove all-invalid, empty, padding and graph replay behavior.
secondary_scan_candidate_not_implemented.roi_reason_for_deferral: Earlier ignore-nonlocal alignment ablation eliminated much of this same work without useful isolated gain. At M128 current count scan is~31680 CTA-level loop iterations/GEMM, M256~56628; this is cached scalar metadata, not weight traffic. Do not present O(B) cleanup as likely3x.

next_if_success: Keep fixed-anchor3x evidence distinct from paired current-incumbent replacement. Test interaction with any validated pipeline-stage candidate in a separately frozen experiment; grid/residency may change guard incidence.
next_if_failure: Archive exact branch-incidence, profile and clean timing evidence; stop schedule tweaking unless new stall attribution identifies a separate cost. Proceed toward a bounded Hopper producer/dequantizer/consumer rewrite only with full cost and precision accounting.
